Walk away if you want. <pulse>{victim}</pulse> will still remember who made them run.

Someone with less nerve than you still had enough courage to ask for help.
This village may look quiet, but we notice when one of us is hurt.

It was an accident

I will accept that for now, but careless hands are still dangerous hands.

Fine. But if it happens again, no one will care what you meant.

Apologize

Good. Words are cheaper than trust, but they are better than another bruise.

I will not call this settled, but I will call it a start.
